title: Paano Basahin ang Meralco Bill?
audience: Homeowners reading their bill before asking for a solar quote
premise: Billing period, kWh from meter readings, and itemised charges: the kWh figure is what matters for solar planning.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the episode plan (data/episodes.json) title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-25.

sources: Sources: Meralco schedule of rates (Nov 2026); FilipiKnow & Moneymax
Meralco bill guides; UMD Extension sizing guide (checked 25 Nov 2026)

cues.text: Alam mo ba kung paano basahin ang Meralco bill mo?
Una, tingnan ang billing period, mga isang buwan 'yan.
Ikalawa, ang kWh: present reading bawas previous reading.
cues.say: Ikalawa, ang kilowatt-hour: present reading, bawas previous reading.

cues.text: 'Yan ang totoong dami ng kuryenteng nagamit mo.
Ikatlo, ang mga charges: generation, transmission, distribution, at iba pa.
Sa solar, ang kWh ang mahalagang basehan, hindi lang ang piso.
cues.say: Sa solar, ang kilowatt-hour ang mahalagang basehan, hindi lang ang piso.

cues.text: Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

sources.title: How to Compute Your Meralco Bill
excerpts: Billing period: the date range of the bill, about 30 days.
kWh consumption = present reading minus previous reading (times the multiplier, usually 1).

sources.title: Summary Schedule of Rates, November 2026 billing
excerpts: Residential rows list per-kWh components: generation, transmission, system loss, distribution, supply, universal charges, FIT-All, lifeline subsidy, etc.

sources.title: How to Compute Meralco Bill
excerpts: The bill lists generation, transmission, system loss, distribution and other charges.
The amount to pay can include remaining balance from a previous bill, so it can be higher than current charges alone.

sources.title: Estimate system size and cost
excerpts: Average your monthly kWh from past bills, then divide by local sun hours to estimate system size.

sources.title: Working on Solar: Design and System Sizing (FS-2023-0655)
excerpts: Preliminary size: energy use divided by peak sun hours; use 12-24 months of kWh history; treat as a first estimate before site-specific design.
